hero_subtitle: Interior painting, wall repair, and clean finishes for apartments, condos and houses.
topbar_painting_services: Residential painting in Montreal and Laval
about_text: Maxime Peinture brings 10 years of experience delivering clean, professional painting services across Montreal. We focus on quality finishes, reliable scheduling, and customer satisfaction.
testimonial_1: “The crew was professional and left the space spotless. Great finish — highly recommend.”
testimonial_2: “Very reliable scheduling and excellent workmanship. Would hire again.”

surface_prep_desc: We protect floors, furniture, and surrounding areas with care to ensure a clean and safe workspace before any painting begins.
wall_repair_desc: We repair cracks, holes, and imperfections to create a smooth, even surface that ensures a flawless final paint finish.
project_section_3_desc: We apply high-quality paints using professional techniques for consistent coverage, crisp lines, and long-lasting results.
exterior_paint_desc: We restore and protect exterior surfaces with durable coatings that withstand weather, wear, and Montreal's seasonal conditions.
products_intro: We work with professional-grade Dulux products chosen for durability, clean finishes, and reliable performance for your home.
product_lifemaster_desc: Low-odour, low-VOC interior paint; Ideal for lived-in spaces; Washable, smooth finish; Designed for healthier indoor air quality
product_lifemaster_can_desc: Durable eggshell finish; Helps hide minor surface imperfections; Excellent touch-up capability; Smooth, washable surface
product_lifemaster_trim_desc: Semi-gloss, durable finish for doors and trim; Excellent adhesion and leveling; Easy to clean and resistant to everyday wear; Provides a smooth, professional-looking surface
product_dul7700_desc: Ultra-white finish for ceilings and walls; Bright, clean coverage; Consistent application; Pairs well with most interior colour schemes
product_bathroom_paint_desc: Designed for high-humidity areas; Helps resist mildew on properly prepared surfaces; Washable and durable; Smooth moisture-resistant finish
product_kitchen_bath_desc: Formulated for moisture-heavy rooms; Durable, washable finish; Handles steam and frequent cleaning; Ideal for kitchens and bathrooms
product_xpert_primer_desc: High-adhesion primer for smooth topcoat application; Improves coverage and hide; Seals repairs and patched areas; Ensures a long-lasting finish
product_cover_stain_desc: Seals water stains and smoke damage; High hiding power; Excellent adhesion; Ideal for repainting problem areas
product_mold_stop_desc: Resists mold and mildew; Ideal for humid or problem areas; Helps maintain a clean, healthy surface; Enhances durability of the topcoat
product_metal_paint_desc: Bonds directly to metal; Resists rust and corrosion; Durable outdoor performance; Ideal for railings, doors, and metal structures
product_metalclad_desc: Industrial-grade enamel; Maximum durability and corrosion resistance; Suitable for harsh environments; Smooth long-lasting finish on metal surfaces
product_distinction_desc: High-hiding interior acrylic paint and primer in one; Designed for high-traffic residential or commercial areas; Excellent resistance to scuffs, stains, and everyday wear; Smooth, washable eggshell finish that stays looking fresh
product_xpert_paint_desc: Versatile coating for multiple surfaces; Excellent adhesion indoors and outdoors; Durable performance; Smooth consistent finish
product_alex_caulk_desc: Flexible, paintable sealant; Ideal for trim, windows, and doors; Fills gaps and cracks before painting; Ensures a cleaner, more professional finish
product_gauging_plaster_desc: High-strength plaster for building up surfaces; Ideal for leveling deep repairs; Creates a solid base before final skim coats
product_spackle_desc: Ready-mixed filler for small repairs; Great for nail holes, dents and minor cracks; Sands easily for a smooth, paint-ready finish
product_joint_tape_desc: Used for reinforcing drywall seams; Prevents cracking along joints; Creates a strong base before applying joint compound
